However, in the execution step, it skips all these planned actions and instead provides an answer based on reasoning without data.

Instead of calling tools to find the required information (countries, capitals, coordinates), it proceeded with unverified reasoning and fabricated data, thus deviating from its established plan and the sub-task of systematically solving the problem.

It presented this information as factual and as if it were sourced from Wikipedia and properly computed, when in reality it was fabricated without any tool use.
